pages.text: This spell allows you to command the spectral swordfish lost in the abyss. Depending on your environment, you can summon variant Skelewags—Stray variants require a cold biome, while Wither variants require the Nether.
A Necro Staff allows you to summon more Skelewags. A Frost Staff increases the summon count and summons Stray variants instead, while a Nether Staff summons Wither variants.
